business_problem: Telstra needed to help frontline contact centre and store employees handle customer interactions faster and more effectively, reduce repeated customer explanations, and let staff find trusted internal information quickly while maintaining privacy, security, and responsible AI controls.
solution_summary: Telstra built and is scaling two in-house generative AI applications on Microsoft technology: One Sentence Summary and Ask Telstra. Using Microsoft Cloud in Telstra’s secure platforms, One Sentence Summary applies Azure OpenAI capabilities to recent customer notes, interactions, and transactions to generate a concise history and status summary for frontline staff before or during service interactions. Ask Telstra combines Azure OpenAI Service with Azure AI Search to let employees query extensive internal knowledge bases through a simple search interface and receive AI-generated answers grounded in trusted corporate information resources. The rollout is supported by Telstra’s modernized data ecosystem, reusable AI capabilities, privacy protections, and responsible AI controls, with an API-first architecture and public-cloud migration work helping the company scale both tools across contact centre and store teams.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Supplies the large language model capabilities used to summarize customer histories and generate answers to employee queries.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Retrieves relevant content from Telstra's internal knowledge bases to ground Ask Telstra responses.

solution_components.name: One Sentence Summary
solution_components.role: Generates a concise summary of a customer's recent history and status from recent notes, interactions, and transactions.

solution_components.name: Ask Telstra
solution_components.role: Lets employees search internal knowledge bases through a simple interface and receive AI-generated responses.

data_flow: For One Sentence Summary, recent customer notes, interactions, and transactions are fed into Azure OpenAI capabilities running on Microsoft Cloud to produce a concise customer history and status summary for frontline staff. For Ask Telstra, employees submit queries through a simple interface, Azure AI Search retrieves relevant internal knowledge-base content, and Azure OpenAI Service generates grounded responses for contact centre and store teams.
business_outcome: The pilots improved frontline productivity and customer interactions, with staff saving time, understanding customer situations faster, reducing repeated explanations, and lowering follow-up contact; Telstra is now rolling both tools out more broadly across frontline teams.
